**Relay run log** — issue #173

- 2026-09-17 05:33Z — Relay picked up this issue for a BB worker run.
- 2026-09-17 06:12Z — Relay BB run pushed an update. Pull request: #421 Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000 No uncommitted changes remained (working tree was already clean). Pushed the branch `bb/relay-173-operations-02-08-enforce-static-packag-thr_bzpr5rk2xr` to origin. ## Summary Implements issue #173: extends `backend/dependency-cruiser.rules.json` with the full nine-rule static dependency-boundary matrix between `packages/`, `modules/`, and `services/`: - `no-module-to-module` (kept) - `no-service-to-service`, `no-service-to-module`, `no-module-to-service` — the five processes talk only through Postgres, never by importing each other or crossing the service boundary - `core-knows-nobody` — core packages import no module or service code - `pi-only-in-agent-runtime` — `pi-agent-core` may only be imported inside `packages/agent-runtime` - `agent-runtime-only-in-agents` — `packages/agent-runtime` may only be imported by `services/semprec-agents`; the API never runs the agent loop - `no-deep-imports` — packages are reachable only through their entry points - `items-store-private` — the item store is only visible inside `packages/data` (CI half of choke-point control; runtime half is #243) Each rule has a failing fixture proving it fires and a passing fixture proving documented valid imports still work, built against a synthetic node_modules-backed mini-repo scanned in isolation via `checkModuleBoundaries`'s `baseDir`. The real full-repo `.dependency-cruiser.cjs` scan excludes that fixtures directory (its nested path would otherwise trip the new anchored rules), and `.gitignore` was given a targeted negation so the fixture's stub `@earendil-works/pi-agent-core` package stays tracked despite the repo-wide `node_modules/` ignore. `packages/agent-runtime/README.md`'s "Enforced boundaries" section was updated to drop a stale reference to the removed combined rule and document the two rules specific to that package. Both `backend/pnpm run verify` (lint, format, build, unit 287/287, pi-import-paths, migration numbering, write-safety, boundaries, integration 1180/1180, e2e 5/5) and `web/pnpm run verify` (lint, format, build, unit 187/187) pass cleanly. The real full-repo `.dependency-cruiser.cjs` scan excludes that fixtures directory, and `.gitignore` carries a targeted negation so the fixture's stub `@earendil-works/pi-agent-core` package stays tracked. `packages/agent-runtime/README.md` documents the two rules specific to that package. Addressed a review finding: renamed a stale, now-mislabeled fixture (`services/svcB/src/goodImport.ts`, which imports another service's public entry point) to `badServiceEntryImport.ts` and added a test asserting it now correctly surfaces as a `no-service-to-service` violation. Both `backend/pnpm run verify` (lint, format, build, unit 310/310, pi-import-paths, migration numbering, write-safety, boundaries clean, integration 1200/1200, e2e 9/9) and `web/pnpm run verify` (lint, format, build, unit 187/187) pass cleanly on the current HEAD, which includes the develop-branch sync merged in earlier (issue #243's runtime roles, realtime reconnect/backpressure work).
